Alex P: Morning async — kicking off phase rollout for ff_phase_v3 at 5% traffic (started 09:00 UTC). What I did: kicked off canary, ran smoke tests, created the rollout dashboard. Blockers: seeing p99 tail spikes on long-seq requests. Today: monitor, coordinate ramp to 20% if stable.

`deploy-bot`: deploy started for service=infer-gateway env=prod release=2026-03-phase-canary target=5% ts=1765432199

Maria G: Product acceptance criteria reminder — p50 < 350ms, p99 < 1200ms during canary window. Also watch hallucination eval set-1 (threshold <= 2%).

Sam R: Noted p99 on `v2-decoder` jumped to ~1.5s around 09:12 UTC, error rate +0.2%. Investigating KV cache warmup vs kernel choice.

Toni K: Saw a noisy host with NVMe saturation, removed from LB at 09:14 — tail latency dropped after. Host id i-0c9b... logging it. If recurrence, will open incident.

Luis M: Repro locally with seq=2048; found fallback to non-optimal kernel selection on that family. PR in #pr-512 with a small selection fix. @Alex P can you review?

Alex P: Reviewed, looks safe. Please run CI and merge when green.

Nate L: Ramp plan: hold at 5% for 30m, then 20% for 30m, then 50% if stable. Rollback triggers: p99 > 1.2s or error +0.5% — immediate rollback and postmortem. Ops ready to cut traffic to 0% on vocal.

Priya J: Dash link: https://redwood.monitoring/d/phase-rollout?panel=canary — added alert: p99 > 1.2s sustained 5m, and quick eval metrics for hallucination set.

Alex P: Ask: owners of models/tools watch closely. Ping here before moving past 20%. Also CR ping @Luis M for merge.

Maria G: Product on standby. :thumbsup:

Sam R: Oncall watching, will call if anything spikes again.

`deploy-bot`: traffic shift to 5% completed. target=ff_phase_v3 status=running

Alex P: Will post a 5m summary in this thread.

Toni K: Added temporary ignore rule for the noisy host to reduce alert noise; will revert if stability holds.

Luis M: Merged runtime patch and deployed to canary; verifying metrics.

Priya J: Last 5m: p50 240ms, p95 420ms, p99 1.05s, error rate stable. :white_check_mark:

Alex P: Good signal. Planning to move to 20% at +30m if green. Speak now to pause.

Nate L: +1 from releases.

Sam R: no objections from oncall.

Maria G: go for it.

`deploy-bot`: traffic shift to 20% completed. target=ff_phase_v3 status=running ts=1765432258

Alex P: Moving into monitoring mode — thanks all, will update again after the 20% window.
